ASR.formula: centered peer Gram eigenspace residual outside subspace using b=H(c-Gw), t=1-2w^Tc+w^TGw; machine-rank/energy-95/energy-99; mean/median stages

CSRC.formula: Spearman average-tie or Kendall tau-b inconsistency=(1-association)/2 over all-three or adjacent stage pairs; mean/max pair aggregation

PCRR.formula: peer-relative witness rank; local denominator 8 or pooled denominator 29; mean/median witness and stage aggregation

PGM.formula: centered peer Gram whitened coordinate (K-1)(v_j^Tb)^2/lambda_j^2; sum/max and mean/median stages

gates.G4: lower95 C_AP > 0, lower95 R_pos > 0, upper95 R_neg <= 0

geometry_contract.kendall: exact tau-b with both-tied pairs excluded from tie-only counts
